splash.caption: Official {STEMRacing} Team!
splash.subheading: Proud winners of {awards} and Luxembourg's representatives at the {finals}

item1.title: Team Creation
item1.text: In October 2022, the first generation of Icarus was formed with our original members; Celia, Nikos, Lukas, and Maria.

item2.title: National Competitions
item2.text: Throughout 2022 and 2025, we attend a total of 3 National Finals in Luxembourg, and 2 showruns, winning multiple trophies along the way.

item3.title: World Finals
item3.text: In June 2025, we qualified to represent Luxembourg at the World Finals in Singapore. We worked tirelessly all summer to then participate in September.

sponsors.title: Our Sponsors
sponsors.description: We are immensely to all our sponsors already working with us. We definitely could not have gone on this journey without them!

efg.name: EFG Bank
efg.description: EFG is our biggest sponsor. We could have not done this journey without them.

eurobank.name: EuroBank
eurobank.description: Eurobank were our first big private sponsors. We are very grateful for their support.

apeeel2.name: APEEEL
apeeel2.description: We are fortunate to have support from our school's parents' association since day one!

esl2.name: European School of Luxembourg II
esl2.description: We are supported by our school, who have provided us with a workspace and many necessary tools.

dreamcars.name: Dream Cars
dreamcars.description: Dream Cars are private car dealership in Luxembourg, who believe in our mission. Thank you!

ortea.name: Ortea
ortea.description: Ortea produce an organic iced tea in Luxembourg and were our first private sponsor.

delphis.name: Delphis Studio
delphis.description: Delphis Studio is a private 3D design studio. They helped us a advised us on many of our graphics.

ratrig.name: RatRig
ratrig.description: RatRig were were very kind to give us a discount a sped up shipping on their CNC Mill.

collaboration.title: Work With Us
collaboration.caption: Want your logo to appear above?
collaboration.description: As a STEM Racing team, we need to fund all our activities ourselves - that is to find sponsors which are willing to support us on our journey. We are mostly seeking financial help, but any material and other contributions are also highly welcomed. These may include discounted printing of documents, banners, merch, and team uniforms, filaments, tools or expert advice in marketing, deign, testing, visual graphics etc.

allocation1.title: Accommodation
allocation1.description: We are required to stay at selected hotels during the World Finals.

allocation2.title: Travel Costs
allocation2.description: World Finals competitions are held in different countries, often far from Luxembourg.

allocation3.title: Competitions Fees
allocation3.description: The World Finals require a team registration and per-member participation fees.

allocation4.title: Manufacturing
allocation4.description: Official Blocks, paint, tools etc. are required are performant and visually appealing car.

allocation5.title: Branding
allocation5.description: Manufacturing uniforms, pit display banners and other marketing materials.

allocation6.title: Sustainability
allocation6.description: We collaborate with companies to off-set our carbon-emissions.

benefit1.title: Education
benefit1.description: You show commitment to supporting education and the young generation.

benefit2.title: Innovation
benefit2.description: You show commitment to innovative ideas, creativity and future engineers.

benefit3.title: Global & Local Exposure
benefit3.description: STEM Racing is a very global competition, but Icarus also heavily promotes the project and themselves in Luxembourg.

benefit4.title: Experience
benefit4.description: Icarus has almost 4 years of experience in the project - by far the most in Luxembourg.

benefit5.title: Visibility Everywhere
benefit5.description: We are committed to making your investment worth it. We'll promote your logo on our materials and we can also agree on custom arrangements.

benefit6.title: Targeted Audience
benefit6.description: By partnering with us, we expose your company to top current and future professionals in the STEM fields.
